question:

Although sqlfluff-templater-dbt is installed sqlfluff is installed, but gets and error that templater 'dbt' is not currently available.

why it says

Error loading config: Requested templater 'dbt' which is not currently available. Try one of raw, jinja, python, placeholder

but when running

sqlfluff lint my_sql_file.sql

or

sqlfluff fix my_sql_file.sql

it works fine, please explain what is the issue is in the pre-commit hook section
title: Error loading config: Requested templater 'dbt' which is not currently available. Try one of raw, jinja, python, placeholder
answer:
pre-commit installs tools in isolated environments (not your environment!) to avoid interfering with your projects

in this case it is installing sqlfluff to its own isolated environment, so your sqlfluff command you're running is unrelated to the one it runs

in order to use dbt you'll want to follow the docs for sqlfluff to configure additional_dependencies to install whatever ancillary sqlfluff plugins you need (like the one for dbt!)
